transform_text_with_transformer: use the Transformer class to normalize and tokenize clinical trial text into space-separated tokens
tokenize_text_with_transformer: use the Transformer class to normalize and tokenize text into a list of tokens
normalize_comparison_operators: use the Normalizer class to normalize comparison operators like less than and greater than in text
tokenize_with_number_masking: use the Tokenizer class to tokenize text and optionally mask numbers with @NUMBER
check_if_string_is_number: use the is_number function to check if a string represents a number or number range
